items.evidence: Loop aspirates 18 uL from master_mix_reservoir A1 and dispenses into each of 96 pcr_plate wells with p20; end-state checks pass.
Step 2 and 3 loops move 1 uL from each colony/primer well to the matching pcr well with p20, with a 3x mix after template; end_state checks pass.
pick_up_tip/drop_tip inside each per-well loop for colony and primer steps; master mix uses one tip into empty wells; no_cross_contamination passed.
Final protocol.comment records sealing and 98C 30s; 30x[98C 10s, 60C 30s, 72C 30s]; 72C 2 min; 4C hold.
Steps and order match the task; comments and metadata accurately describe the actions performed, with no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol follows all four steps: 18 µL master mix, 1 µL template with 3x mix, 1 µL primer, and a recorded seal and thermocycling comment. Fresh tips are used per colony and per primer, all measured checks pass, and the comments match what the code does.
